feedback: In the introduction, correct the false claim that the server sends its private key to the browser, as servers never transmit their private keys.
Explain technical terms like TLS, cipher suite, X.509 certificate, PKI, and AEAD in plain English since this is intended for absolute beginners.
Remove jargon-heavy paragraphs about OCSP, CRLs, HSTS, and TLS 1.3 details from the main sections or simplify them completely for a beginner audience.
Add at least one concrete, realistic example in the text, such as logging into an online bank account, to show how HTTPS protects user data in practice.
